name: Zainab Azim for Mayor of Milton
one_liner: A municipal campaign site promoting Zainab Azim for Mayor of Milton, Ontario.
what_you_sell: The website does not sell any product or service; it is a political campaign website for Zainab Azim's 2026 candidacy for Mayor of Milton.
target_group: The campaign targets residents, voters, and political donors located in Milton, Ontario ahead of the 2026 municipal election. A good prospect is a local resident interested in municipal governance, transit improvements, and local economic growth. The campaign does not sell products or services to businesses.
b2c_note: There is no commercial business side to this organisation, as it is a municipal political campaign focused entirely on local voters and residents.
who_uses_it: Milton residents, voters, and volunteers visiting the site to view candidate plans, event schedules, and news updates.
who_pays_for_it: Individual campaign donors and financial supporters contributing to the mayoral campaign.
who_buys_it: Individual campaign donors and voters in Milton, Ontario.
